parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Public DNS configuration.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
><warning>If you specify a wide time range, many logs may be returned. This can cause a query timeout or inaccurate results.></warning>

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en.

parameters.name: Module
parameters.description:
The module type.

- AUTHORITY (default): public authoritative DNS

- RECURSION: public recursive DNS

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: QueryCondition
parameters.description:
The query parameters.

- sourceIp: the source IP address

- queryNameFuzzy: the domain name (fuzzy match)

- queryType: the record type

- value: the resolution result

- status: the status

- serverIp: the IP address of the resolution server

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
